title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to view excel reports (Excel Layout) directly from the web without downloading files (Excel Online)
summary: Excel layouts in Business Central can be viewed directly in a web browser using Excel Online instead of downloading files, provided OneDrive integration is configured for system features. This approach respects Business Central filters and works across Windows and macOS devices.
key_points: Excel layouts are based on Microsoft Excel workbooks and support familiar Excel features like formulas, PivotTables, and PivotCharts
Enabling 'Use OneDrive for system features' automatically opens Excel and Word reports in online versions instead of downloading them
Excel for web respects filters from Business Central pages, showing the same filtered rows and columns
Business Central limits exported workbooks to 100 columns when OneDrive is configured for system features
Excel Online works on any device with a supported browser, though Excel desktop add-in only works on Windows

quotes.text: If your organization has configured OneDrive for system features, the Excel workbook is opened in your browser by using Excel for the web.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the key requirement and outcome for viewing reports directly in the browser without downloads

quotes.text: Business Central automatically limits the exported workbook to 100 columns when OneDrive is configured for system features.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important constraint to be aware of when working with tables containing many columns in Excel Online
